::: {#def-interventional-npsem .theorem}
# Interventional NPSEM

The NPSEM obtained from an NPSEM $\mathcal{M}$ with structural equations $\{f_V:V\in\mathbf{V}\}$ by replacing the structural equations of the variables in $\mathbf{E}$ with the intervention equations of intervention regime $\Gamma$:

$$
\mathcal{M}^{(\Gamma)}=\{f_V^{(\Gamma)}:V\in\mathbf{V}\},\qquad f_V^{(\Gamma)}=\begin{cases}h_V&\text{if }V\in\mathbf{E},\\ f_V&\text{otherwise.}\end{cases}
$$

Every equation outside $\mathbf{E}$ is unchanged. This is modularity.
:::
